sentences.text:
Through:
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge
 Order
14-08-2024
The petitioners have filed the instant petition challenging FIR No.7/2024 for offences under Sections 406 and 498A of IPC registered with Police Station Women Cell Srinagar.
It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that there are no specific allegations against the petitioners in the impugned FIR.

It has been further contended that on the basis of general allegations without any particulars of the property alleged to have misappropriated by the petitioners, it was not open to respondent no.1 to register the FIR.

It has been also contended that on account of a matrimonial discord between respondent no.2 and petitioner no.1, the said respondent has roped in all the family members of petitioner no.1 by making omnibus allegations.
Issue notice to the respondents, subject to petitioners' taking necessary steps within a week's time.
Notice be sent to respondent no.2 through concerned Police Station as well.
In the meanwhile, the investigation in the impugned FIR shall stay.
